contract.source: Only /create's successful Discord receipt plus failed creator persistence plus failed compensation is untracked orphan evidence. It bypasses the reconcile queue today; the tests use real slash dispatch and separately pin real reconcile non-interference.
contract.storage: voice_orphan_ledger: guild_id text, channel_id text, reason text, recorded_at timestamptz; database-enforced unique guild/channel identity; reason creator_compensation_failed; observation time; no user-controlled text
contract.retention: 1000 rows per guild, oldest recorded_at first; repeated identity preserves first evidence and cannot evict another row; parallel append/trim preserves the bound and other guilds
contract.read: /voice-orphans page:integer, default 1, 10 whole newest-first rows per page, RFC3339 times, Page n of total, guild context and copyable next-page invocation; deterministic replay and independent-pool restart; other guilds excluded
contract.authorization: Manage Channels or Administrator from trusted guild-role facts; refuse non-staff and forged permission claims before constructing or querying any store, including access_controls; observed through factory counts and SQLx receipts with a real SELECT sanity control
contract.safety: All replies ephemeral, bounded and mention-safe; malformed/past-end page refuses; reads never mutate evidence or Discord; no auto-deletion
contract.controls: Byte-identical successful-create and successful-compensation replies; unknown create receipt invents no channel; real tracked-ghost reconcile ignores arbitrary live residue; failed room rollback retains existing tracked/reservation compensation witness
